WITH store_sales_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        dd.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer AS c
    JOIN store_sales AS ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        dd.d_year
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        CASE
            WHEN s.dyear = 1998 AND s.next_dyear = 1998 + 1 AND s.year_total > 0
                THEN s.next_year_total / s.year_total
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS ratio_next_year
    FROM (
        SELECT
            st.*,
            LEAD(st.dyear) OVER (PARTITION BY st.customer_id ORDER BY st.dyear) AS next_dyear,
            LEAD(st.year_total) OVER (PARTITION BY st.customer_id ORDER BY st.dyear) AS next_year_total
        FROM store_sales_totals AS st
    ) AS s
),
web_sales_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c.c_login AS customer_login,
        c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        dd.d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer AS c
    JOIN web_sales AS ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY
        c.c_customer_id,
        c.c_first_name,
        c.c_last_name,
        c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c.c_birth_country,
        c.c_login,
        c.c_email_address,
        dd.d_year
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        CASE
            WHEN s.dyear = 1998 AND s.next_dyear = 1998 + 1 AND s.year_total > 0
                THEN s.next_year_total / s.year_total
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS ratio_next_year
    FROM (
        SELECT
            st.*,
            LEAD(st.dyear) OVER (PARTITION BY st.customer_id ORDER BY st.dyear) AS next_dyear,
            LEAD(st.year_total) OVER (PARTITION BY st.customer_id ORDER BY st.dyear) AS next_year_total
        FROM web_sales_totals AS st
    ) AS s
)
SELECT
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM store_sales_agg AS t_s_secyear
JOIN store_sales_agg AS t_s_firstyear
    ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN web_sales_agg AS t_w_secyear
    ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id
JOIN web_sales_agg AS t_w_firstyear
    ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id
WHERE
    t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's'
    AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w'
    AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's'
    AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w'
    AND t_s_firstyear.dyear = 1998
    AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
    AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = 1998
    AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 1998 + 1
    AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0
    AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
    AND t_w_firstyear.ratio_next_year > t_s_firstyear.ratio_next_year
ORDER BY
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
